attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited has issued a clarification regarding its uploaded financial results. The amounts mentioned on Page 7 under Point C in the Notes to Financial Statements are in Crores and not in Millions. The company requests the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited to take this correction on record.

attchmntText: MV Electrosystems Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: MV Electrosystems Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and subsequently approved by the Board. The company submitted the Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors M/s. Sanmarks & Associates, Chartered Accountants, along with the unaudited financial results, statement of assets and liability, cash flow statement, and related party transactions. The Board meeting commenced at 01:00 P.M. IST and concluded at 4:00 P.M. IST. The information is available on the company website at www.mvelectrosystems.com.
